text:
incident-bot: P1 GPU capacity alert — us-west-2 pool exhausted, queue growth > 5k, sustained for 3m. Autoscaler failing with repeated errors: `scaleup_rejected: quota_exceeded`. Dashboards: https://dash.redwood/infrastructure/us-west-2/queue, runbook: #incident-playbooks/gpu-surge :rotating_light:

incident-bot: paging @sophia (oncall) and @ryan (infra)

sophia (oncall): on it. taking pager. initial ask: what's blocked? any quick mitigation to stop customer throttles?

ryan (infra): digging into autoscaler logs now. seeing this loop in the controller:
```
2026-03-14T22:07:10Z controller: request scale up -> provider.reqs -> error: QuotaExceeded: Requested 80 GPUs, limit 200, current_used 200
2026-03-14T22:07:11Z controller: retrying -> backoff
```
Looks like we hit the account GPU quota (hard limit) not a bug in policy. autoscaler respected provider error and stopped.

matt (scheduler): queue backlog is dominated by a few tenants doing high-concurrency batch infer. top offenders: tenant:fin-analytics (1200 jobs), tenant:ads-batch (900 jobs). We can shed or reroute low-priority work — can we apply per-tenant soft limits?

sophia (oncall): good. two immediate actions: 1) protect interactive/low-latency customers by throttling batch jobs, 2) trigger cross-region failover for eligible traffic to eu-west-1. Who can run the routing change?

tariq (engineer): I can flip routing for non-SLO traffic. quick command (traffic-router):
```
# mark tenant groups for failover
traffic-router set-policy --region us-west-2 --fallback-region eu-west-1 --selector 'workload=batch' --dry-run
traffic-router set-policy --region us-west-2 --fallback-region eu-west-1 --selector 'workload=batch' --commit
```
I'll run dry-run then commit in 60s.

anne (cust-suc): compiling affected customer list now. earliest hits: fin-analytics (high), travel-saas (med), social-lite (low). Travel-saas has a currently open ticket about latency; we'll prioritize notifying travel-saas and fin-analytics (they're enterprise). Drafting comms: "We detected elevated queueing in us-west-2 and are rerouting batch traffic to eu-west-1 and enabling emergency throttles to protect interactive requests."

ryan (infra): also opened ticket with cloud provider for temporary quota bump: INC-11892 (severity: high). ETA from provider unknown. In parallel I can spin up a smaller GPU flavor in us-west-2 spare AZ to buy time (if scheduler allows mixed instance types).

matt (scheduler): we can enable mixed-instance immediate: `scheduler set-pool-config --pool gpu-usw2 --allow-mixed true --max-instances 20` Doing that now. This should accept smaller GPU nodes (v100-style) and allow some scale-up while provider processes quota.

ops-bot: deploy started: autoscaler-hotfix rev `a1b2c3d` — temporarily relaxes `min_required_gpus_for_large_jobs` so we can backfill smaller nodes. CI: https://ci.redwood/builds/44321 :rocket:

sophia (oncall): executing tenant throttles now — applying rate limits to batch workloads.

sophia (oncall): tariq, did the routing commit finish?

tariq (engineer): committed. traffic shifted ~35% of batch volume to eu-west-1. observing increased cross-region latency but overall queue length in us-west-2 dropping.

ryan (infra): mixed-instance nodes starting; we have +12 GPUs in pool within 4 minutes. autoscaler notices capacity and processed some backlog.

matt (scheduler): queue size trending down from 5.2k -> 1.1k in 8m after throttles + routing + mixed nodes. interactive latency back to SLO for most customers.

anne (cust-suc): sent interim notice to fin-analytics & travel-saas. flagged for follow-up with engineering postmortem.

incident-bot: mitigation checklist updated: routed batch -> eu-west-1, applied tenant throttles, enabled mixed-instance backfill, provider ticket INC-11892.

sophia (oncall): marking incident as "mitigated" for customer impact but still monitoring. we'll keep the channel open for postmortem notes and action items.

sophia (oncall): quick timeline notes for postmortem:
- 22:07:10 root cause: account GPU quota hit prevented autoscaler scale-up
- 22:08:00 routing policy commit for batch workloads to eu-west-1 (tariq)
- 22:09:30 mixed-instance backfill enabled (matt)
- 22:11:15 queue returned below warning threshold

ryan (infra): immediate actions (short-term):
- Request permanent quota increase with provider (owner: ryan) — ticket INC-11892
- Add pre-warm automation: if queue > X and predicted growth rate > Y, pre-request capacity with provider (owner: ryan/matt)

tariq (engineer): infra changes (postmortem):
- Add routing weight autoscaling: auto-shift non-latency traffic to other regions when pool saturation > 80% (owner: tariq)
- Add tenant-level circuit-breakers in scheduler to prevent single tenants from monopolizing pool (owner: matt)

anne (cust-suc): comms + CS (postmortem):
- Draft customer-facing postmortem and personalized outreach for fin-analytics and travel-saas (owner: anne)

sophia (oncall): runbook/alerting improvements (postmortem):
- Alert should differentiate between "provider quota" vs "autoscaler failure". Add explicit paging for provider quota so ops can hit quota processes faster (owner: sophia)
- Add a runbook step: verify provider quota before scaling to autoscale thresholds (owner: ryan)

matt (scheduler): CI action: add smoke test that simulates quota_limit errors and validates scheduler backfill path (owner: matt).

ops-bot: NOTE: created postmortem ticket PM-5531 with sections: timeline, impact, root cause, mitigations, action items. Link: https://pm.redwood/PM-5531

sophia (oncall): final notes: no lost data, no decrypted customer inputs exposed. Some tenants saw degraded throughput for ~9 minutes, two enterprise tenants escalated to CS. We'll schedule a 1h postmortem sync tomorrow with owners above.

anne (cust-suc): adding customer follow-up tasks to CS board now.

ryan (infra): provider confirmed temporary quota bump granted to cover urgent demand. We still need long-term quota & pre-warm automation.

sophia (oncall): thanks everyone. closing incident channel for active page but keeping this thread for postmortem edits. :white_check_mark:

--end of thread--
